label: E-stop circuit
comment: the area's emergency-stop state (immediate); TRUE = energized (user 2026-10-29, live: FALSE on every area with an e-stop pressed)

label: Safety and emergency conditions
comment: the area's safety cut, extended name (the CPU's, C-052)

label: Safety conditions
comment: the sorter areas' second cut (on the CPU; PL5 C-052 open)

label: Power enabled
comment: the safety cut where the area keeps the short name

label: Reset
comment: the reset command itself - a pulse the page cannot follow (user 2026-10-29): not shown, not read

label: Awaiting reset
comment: TRUE while the area waits for a reset (the user adds it to 05_EM_STATE in TIA, 2026-10-29; PL5 to generate it later) - a project without it skips the row

label: E-stop push buttons
comment: TRUE = the cause is OK (user 2026-10-29, live: FALSE while an e-stop is pressed)

label: E-stop push buttons
comment: the name before C-052 - a row whose member a project lacks is skipped

label: Node failed
comment: {node} = the station's PROFINET name and IP, as PL5 names the member; TRUE = failed (user 2026-10-29, live: TRUE on exactly the nodes whose cabinet channel is active)

label: Not installed
comment: TRUE = flagged not installed (user 2026-10-29); read every refresh, the node and the devices on it get a violet border

label: E-stop
comment: TRUE = released (user 2026-10-29, live: FALSE on the e-stop whose channel is active)

label: Feedback error
comment: TRUE = no error, despite the name (user 2026-10-29, live: FALSE on exactly the contactors whose channel is active)

label: Door alarm
comment: TRUE = no alarm, despite the name (user 2026-10-29, live: TRUE on every closed door)
